footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the Reporting Person under the Issuer's 2021 Omnibus Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents the contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock. The RSUs vest as to 1,980 shares on 10/21/2027, 1,980 shares on 10/21/2028 and 1,981 shares on 10/21/2029, provided that the Reporting Person remains in continuous service with the Issuer through each such vesting date.
